title: bug: a launch outage carried into a verified-local iteration never ends in moe-agent.ps1: the VM route turns every launch probe into a no-launch while the outage suppresses every claim (ps1 twin of task-cc4213c0)
description: Repro: a legacy-profile ps1 worker seat reaches 3 fast launch failures (LaunchOutage=true, task released); the project flips to verified-local (ready) while the wrapper lives; every later iteration prints MOE_LAUNCH_PROBE, then the VM route's taskless skip suppresses the probe, so the seat never claims again. Fix: port sh 8ca6a40b (task-cc4213c0): right after Invoke-MoeVerifiedLocalGate, when $script:MoeVmRoute -and $script:LaunchOutage, print the same [launch-outage] line, post one best-effort #general line and reset the six launch-success variables; port its postflight-vm-route row (and fake-proxy knob) to postflight-vm-route.ps1. Hand-forward: comment from architect-1dd28c7c on task-62ec51f1 (CQ-M07n), which lands the ps1 outage exemption.
definitionOfDone: moe-agent.ps1 ends a carried-over launch outage on the first VM-route iteration with the sh twin's strings (8ca6a40b), resetting the streak, backoff and four outage variables
A postflight-vm-route.ps1 row reproduces the carry-over (legacy outage, then verified-local ready) and proves the seat claims again with no host CLI launch
postflight-vm-route.ps1 passes on powershell.exe and pwsh.exe; parity-check.sh passes; moe-agent.ps1 keeps its UTF-8 BOM

implementationPlan.description:
The fix, ported from sh 8ca6a40b (task-cc4213c0). In scripts/moe-agent.ps1's main loop, insert ONE guarded block:
- after the line `    if ($Role -eq 'worker' -or $Role -eq 'qa') { Invoke-MoeVerifiedLocalGate }` (which sits under `# CQ-M07n1: before every pre-flight RPC, including -AutoClaim:$false seats.`);
- before the blank line and `    if ($AutoClaim) {`.

It is a pure insertion: no other line changes and no reflow. Three other open rows edit this file: 1dfec7a4 (the VM taskless skip chain), cd3887fe (MOE_USAGE_RECEIPT_FILE) and 6b3ab9d8 (the seat-runner Start-Process). Edit in place in your worktree with your editing tool, keeping the UTF-8 BOM and LF line endings. The block, with 4-space indent like its neighbours:
```
    # Launch outage mode is host-CLI state. The VM route never enters it (the
    # fast-failure branch gates entry on -not $script:MoeVmRoute) and turns a probe
    # into a no-launch, so an outage carried over from a legacy iteration of this
    # wrapper process would suppress every claim forever (task-bbd7ad2d; sh twin
    # task-cc4213c0). The route's own job failures restart the shared streak and
    # backoff from 0.
    if ($script:MoeVmRoute -and $script:LaunchOutage) {
        Write-Host "[launch-outage] The verified-local VM route runs this seat's sessions in its VM, never the host CLI: launch outage over, claiming resumes." -ForegroundColor Green
        if ($generalChannelId) {
            $launchOkMsg = "${WorkerId}: the verified-local VM route runs this seat's sessions in its VM, never the host CLI, after $($script:LaunchFailStreak) host launch failures. Launch outage over: claiming resumes."
            try { Invoke-MoeRpc -Tool "chat_send" -Args @{ channel = $generalChannelId; workerId = $WorkerId; content = $launchOkMsg } | Out-Null } catch {}
        }
        $script:LaunchFailStreak = 0
        $script:LaunchFailBackoffSec = 0
        $script:LaunchOutage = $false
        $script:LaunchOutageHeldTaskId = ''
        $script:LaunchOutageReleaseTried = ''
        $script:LaunchOutageAnnounce = $false
    }
```
Why each part:
- The condition text must stay exactly `$script:MoeVmRoute -and $script:LaunchOutage`: step 1's in-process check finds the block by it.
- `${WorkerId}:` needs the braces, because `$WorkerId:` parses as a drive-qualified variable.
- The message reads the streak before the resets.
- $generalChannelId still holds the previous iteration's id here, because the AutoClaim pre-flight below resets it to $null and re-resolves it after the team join. The sh GENERAL_CHANNEL_ID behaves the same.
- The six resets are the launch-success branch's: the else after the launch-failure classifier.

Error handling: the #general post is best-effort (try/catch, skipped without a channel id) and never stops the seat or skips a reset. Legacy, observe and unreadable seats never set $script:MoeVmRoute, because Invoke-MoeVerifiedLocalGate returns early for them. Their outage behavior (postflight.ps1 scenario AH) is therefore byte-for-byte unchanged, and VM seats still never enter the outage themselves (62ec51f1's exemption).

Then check the file: [System.Management.Automation.Language.Parser]::ParseFile returns no errors on powershell.exe and pwsh.exe, and `head -c3 scripts/moe-agent.ps1 | od -An -tx1` is `ef bb bf`.
